pieces.name: Crate_Storage
pieces.notes: Steel supply crate with ribs, latches and a label.

pieces.name: Crate_Large
pieces.notes: Large cargo container with hazard band and corner guards.

pieces.name: Crate_Stack
pieces.notes: Two crates and a small case stacked together.

pieces.name: Barrel
pieces.notes: Chemical drum with rings and a warning band.

pieces.name: Shelf_Storage
pieces.notes: 3 m industrial shelving with boxes and canisters (back against a wall).

pieces.name: Locker_Single
pieces.notes: Single 2 m steel locker with vents and a handle.

pieces.name: Locker_Row
pieces.notes: Three lockers side by side, 1.8 m wide.

pieces.name: Bed_Bunk
pieces.notes: Steel bunk bed with two mattresses, pillows, blankets and a ladder.

pieces.name: Bed_Medical
pieces.notes: Medical / examination bed with straps and a monitor arm.

pieces.name: Table_Dining
pieces.notes: 3 m mess table with a steel frame.

pieces.name: Chair
pieces.notes: Simple steel chair, seat facing -Z (Unity).

pieces.name: Sofa
pieces.notes: Worn red three-seat sofa (from the kitchen / living concept).

pieces.name: Kitchen_Counter
pieces.notes: 3 m kitchen run: cabinets, a sink, a stove, wall cupboards (back against a wall).

pieces.name: Fridge
pieces.notes: Tall steel fridge with two doors.

pieces.name: Shower_Stall
pieces.notes: 1.4 m tiled shower cubicle with partitions, shower head and drain (open side faces -Z in Unity).

pieces.name: Sink_Row
pieces.notes: Three wash basins on a counter with a long mirror (back against a wall).

pieces.name: Toilet_Stall
pieces.notes: Toilet cubicle with partitions and a half-open door (open side faces -Z in Unity).

pieces.name: Lab_Table
pieces.notes: Lab bench with drawers, sample jars, a microscope and a tablet.

pieces.name: Workbench
pieces.notes: Heavy workbench with a vice, tools, a pegboard and a work lamp (back against a wall).

pieces.name: Med_Cabinet
pieces.notes: Tall glass-front cabinet with glowing sample vials (back against a wall).

pieces.name: Floor_Tile_4m
pieces.notes: 4 x 4 m steel deck plate, top at 0. Tile it on a 4 m grid.

pieces.name: Floor_Tile_Clean_4m
pieces.notes: 4 x 4 m lighter lab floor with a centre seam, for the living quarters.

pieces.name: Floor_Grate_4m
pieces.notes: 4 x 4 m grating over a dark service pit, for corridors.

pieces.name: Floor_Tile_Bath_4m
pieces.notes: 4 x 4 m small white tiles for bathrooms and the medical bay.

pieces.name: Floor_Hazard_Strip_4m
pieces.notes: Painted hazard stripes, 4 x 0.6 m. Lies on top of any floor tile.

pieces.name: Floor_Void_Slab
pieces.notes: Huge dark base slab under a level, so gaps between floor pieces never show light.

pieces.name: Floor_Hub_Disc
pieces.notes: Round floor for a 9 m hub with ring inlays and a glowing service ring. Pivot at the centre.

pieces.name: Floor_Arena_Disc
pieces.notes: Round floor for the 25 m laboratory / boss arena: rings, radial seams and a glowing summoning circle in the middle. Pivot at the centre.

pieces.name: Wall_Panel_4m
pieces.notes: 4 m long, 5 m tall, 0.5 m thick wall panel, detailed on both faces. Centred on the wall line.

pieces.name: Wall_Panel_2m
pieces.notes: 2 m version of Wall_Panel_4m for closing gaps.

pieces.name: Wall_Panel_4m_Vent
pieces.notes: Wall panel with a ventilation grille.

pieces.name: Wall_Panel_4m_Pipes
pieces.notes: Wall panel with a pipe run on its front face.

pieces.name: Wall_Panel_4m_B3
pieces.notes: Wall panel with the painted 'B-3' sector marking.

pieces.name: Wall_Pillar
pieces.notes: Structural steel pillar, 1 m square and 5.4 m tall: riveted flanges, collars and a small amber service light near the foot. Put one on every wall joint.

pieces.name: Wall_Pillar_Large
pieces.notes: 2 m heavy support column, 8 m tall, for big halls and the arena rim.

pieces.name: Wall_Cap_End
pieces.notes: Slim end post that finishes a wall run at an opening.

pieces.name: Rock_Mass_4m
pieces.notes: Raw rock and concrete backfill, 4 m long and 6 m deep, that sits behind an outer wall (front at the wall's back face, mass toward +Z in Unity). Hides floor edges and frames the level.

pieces.name: Door_Sliding
pieces.notes: 6 m wall section with a 3 x 3.4 m sliding double door. Opens on its own when a character comes near (Gate with Auto Open). Fits a 6 m gap in a wall run.

pieces.name: Gate_Blast
pieces.notes: Event gate: 8 m heavy wall section with a 4 x 4.2 m split blast door and a red status bar that turns green when open. Closed until a script calls Gate.Open() (or Gate.Open("id")).

pieces.name: Gate_Shutter
pieces.notes: Event gate: 6 m wall section with a 4 x 4 m shutter that sinks into the floor when opened.

pieces.name: Door_Airlock_Locked
pieces.notes: Decoration: a sealed round vault door set into a 4 m wall panel (never opens).

pieces.name: Stairs_Wide
pieces.notes: 4 m wide stairs climbing 3 m over 5.4 m toward +Z (Unity), with railings. Meets Catwalk_4m. An invisible ramp gives smooth walking.

pieces.name: Stairs_Short
pieces.notes: 4 m wide, three steps up 0.6 m toward +Z (Unity). For daises and raised rooms.

pieces.name: Railing_4m
pieces.notes: 4 m safety railing along X, 1.1 m tall.

pieces.name: Railing_2m
pieces.notes: 2 m safety railing along X.

pieces.name: Catwalk_4m
pieces.notes: 4 m long, 2.4 m wide grated walkway 3 m up on legs, railings both sides.

pieces.name: Catwalk_4m_Wall
pieces.notes: 4 m catwalk with a railing on the front (-Z in Unity) only, to run along a wall.

pieces.name: Catwalk_Landing
pieces.notes: 2.4 x 2.4 m catwalk landing without railings, where stairs meet a walkway.

pieces.name: Platform_Dais_6m
pieces.notes: Round two-tier dais, 6 m radius and 0.5 m tall, with a glowing edge. Pivot at the centre.

pieces.name: Ceiling_Panel_4m
pieces.notes: 4 x 4 m ceiling panel with a recessed light; its pivot is the underside. Put it at wall height for third-person interiors (the isometric demo leaves ceilings off so the camera can see in).

pieces.name: Pipe_Large_4m
pieces.notes: 4 m heavy pipe (0.45 m) along X on two floor saddles. Chain them end to end.

pieces.name: Pipe_Wall_Run_4m
pieces.notes: Three pipes and a cable tray along X, mounted on a wall face (back at 0, sticks out to -Z in Unity).

pieces.name: Pipe_Vertical_5m
pieces.notes: Vertical 5 m pipe with brackets, for wall corners and machine rooms.

pieces.name: Pipe_Elbow
pieces.notes: Large pipe rising out of the floor and bending 90 degrees toward -Z (Unity).

pieces.name: Pipe_U_Bend
pieces.notes: Two upright pipes joined by a U-bend at the floor, with a cable wrapped around (concept 'Pipe & Cable').

pieces.name: Cable_Hanging_4m
pieces.notes: Bundle of sagging cables spanning 4 m along X at 4.5 m height (between pillars or across a corridor).

pieces.name: Lamp_Wall_Cold
pieces.notes: Wall-mounted caged lamp with a cold blue light; back on the wall face.

pieces.name: Lamp_Emergency
pieces.notes: Wall-mounted orange emergency lamp that flickers; back on the wall face.

pieces.name: Lamp_Alarm_Red
pieces.notes: Red rotating-style alarm beacon for wall faces near gates.

pieces.name: Light_Floor_Strip_2m
pieces.notes: 2 m glowing guide strip on the floor along X (no light source, just glow).

pieces.name: Light_Post
pieces.notes: Free-standing work light on a weighted base.

pieces.name: Console_Control
pieces.notes: Control desk with three monitors and button panels (front faces -Z in Unity).

pieces.name: Terminal_Wall
pieces.notes: Wall terminal with a glowing screen and keypad; back on the wall face.

pieces.name: Terminal_Offline
pieces.notes: Dead monitor and keyboard on a small desk, a few lines still glowing.

pieces.name: Server_Rack
pieces.notes: 2.2 m server cabinet with rows of status lights.

pieces.name: Generator_Unit
pieces.notes: Boxy power unit with fan housings, gauges and warm status lamps.

pieces.name: Machine_Pump
pieces.notes: Big boiler / pump tank with gauges, pipes into the floor and orange work lights (technical room centrepiece).

pieces.name: Containment_Tube
pieces.notes: 3 m specimen tube: steel base and cap, glowing liquid with a dark figure inside.

pieces.name: Containment_Tube_Broken
pieces.notes: Smashed specimen tube: empty, glass gone, a few bent bars and a drained base.

pieces.name: Containment_Tube_Large
pieces.notes: The laboratory's centrepiece: a 9 m containment cylinder with a huge dark specimen, cage bars, machinery crown and cables.

pieces.name: Machine_Column
pieces.notes: 9 m dark machinery column from the lab concept: a plated core with brackets, a pipe bundle, cyan and orange status lights and a heavy foot. Ring them around the lab's centre.

pieces.name: Reactor_Column
pieces.notes: The hub's 15 m energy column from the concept: a machinery drum, a bright core in a caged lower chamber, a ribbed dark housing with glowing slots, a narrow upper core between girders, crown and feeder pipes. Stands on Platform_Dais_6m.

pieces.name: Elevator_Platform
pieces.notes: 6 x 6 m freight elevator: raised platform, corner guide rails up into the dark, call console. Its trigger and lift motion are left for your own script.

pieces.name: Vent_Wall
pieces.notes: Ventilation unit with louvres for wall faces (concept 'Ventilation').

pieces.name: Broken_Robot
pieces.notes: Wrecked droid: cracked skull-like head, torso plates and a torn arm with cables.

pieces.name: Debris_Scrap
pieces.notes: Scattered panels, bolts and a bent pipe for the floor.

pieces.name: Floor_Grime
pieces.notes: Flat dirt: oil stains, a dark water puddle and a few scattered papers, about 3 m across. Scatter over any floor to break up the tiling (the concept's floors are never clean).

pieces.name: Cable_Floor_Run
pieces.notes: Bundle of three loose cables snaking 4 m along X across the floor, for clutter between machines.

pieces.name: Light_Fill_Cold
pieces.notes: Invisible cold ceiling light that lifts a room's mid-tones (the concept's overhead panels).

pieces.name: Light_Fill_Warm
pieces.notes: Invisible warm ceiling light for workshops and living areas.
